title: AP High Court Directs Release Of PwD Medical Student's Certificate, Orders Inquiry Into Alleged Discrimination By Professor
description: Granting interim relief to an M.S. General Surgery student with 78% locomotor disability, the Andhra Pradesh High Court directed Andhra Medical College to issue provisional course completion certificate and release the original academic documents to enable him to participate in the NEET Super Specialty counselling, earlier denied over lack of attendance.� While doing so, the Court also suo motu impleaded the concerned Professor of General Surgery, who allegedly harassed the petitioner on account
